style.name: Blackboard
style.notes: The house look for x-animation, in the 3Blue1Brown tradition: a black stage, Computer Modern type, colour as meaning, thin strokes, one second of smootherstep for every move. Both engines read this file (kit/python/xcore/tokens.py and kit/remotion/theme.ts), so a value changed here changes Manim and Remotion together. Sizes are px on the 1920x1080 authoring canvas unless a key says otherwise. Sources for the values: docs/RESEARCH.md.

role.notes: Default meaning of each colour. A video may reassign roles in its video.json, but a role keeps its colour for the whole video.
role.subject: blue

tint.notes: Shapes that carry a colour role use a full-strength stroke and a SOLID tint of the same hue mixed over the backdrop (never a translucent fill, which lets lines behind show through).

font.notes: Latin Modern is the OpenType Computer Modern. Both engines load the same files from public/fonts, so type is identical across an engine switch. Math is set by Typst in New Computer Modern Math.

type.notes: Em size in px at 1080p. Nothing on screen is ever smaller than `min` after scaling or a camera move.

stroke.notes: Stroke widths in px at 1080p. Manim stroke_width = px / 1.35.

motion.notes: Seconds. `smooth` is smootherstep 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3, the curve 3Blue1Brown's Manim uses for everything. Manim CE's own `smooth` is a different sigmoid, so the kit installs this one as the default.

render.notes: draft is for checking, preview for sending a quick look, final is the master. `fps` here is the default; a video sets its own in video.json.
